digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and tickets clone management
propositions: The persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume is not refreshed during redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, preserving divergent history.
The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset.
The ensure script must implement explicit-refspec fetch, epoch-aware reconvergence for compatible stores, and narrow pre-epoch adoption only when local tip is ancestor of prior readable remote tip.
autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh, preventing ensure-script changes from auto-deploying; the script must be added to BOT_PATHS.
Convergence failure must remain best-effort and never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote, with operator-readable warnings for fetch failures and adoption refusals.
After merge, a one-time hand-bootstrap must update /var/lib/rebar/mirror, install autodeploy.sh preserving owner 502:502, and start rebar-autodeploy.service to enable future self-deployment.
